title: Wuwei Ganlu and Myricetin alleviate rheumatoid arthritis by inhibiting M1 macrophage polarization through modulation of SHBG/SREBP1-mediated lipid metabolism.
authors: Wen, Yuanyuan; Wang, Yutong; Zhuang, Youyi; Xu, Guiwen; Zhang, Yun; Zhang, Shijie; Xu, Anjing; Chen, Xu; Li, Kefeng; Cai, Weiwei; Nhamdriel, Tsedien; Hou, Bao; Sun, Haijian
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究藏药五味甘露和杨梅素通过SHBG/SREBP1调控巨噬细胞脂代谢抑制M1极化缓解类风湿关节炎，核心为细胞代谢与炎症机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is primarily characterized by imbalanced macrophage polarization. Wuwei Ganlu (WGL), a classical Tibetan topical formula, has been widely used in RA management. PURPOSE: Nonetheless, the underlying mechanisms of WGL in protecting against RA and the bioactive components in WGL remain unclear. STUDY DESIGN: This study employs multi-omics strategies, to elucidate the role and mechanism of the main bioactive component within WGL in macrophage polarization and RA. METHODS: The macrophage polarization was assessed by flow cytometer, and the molecular mechanism of WGL was investigated using RNA sequencing, gene interference technology, molecular docking, and pharmacology experiments. RESULTS: WGL inhibited macrophage M1 polarization by inhibiting reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation and IL-6/iNOS expression. RNA sequencing and pathway enrichment analysis identified that WGL might affect lipid metabolism by acting on sex hormone-binding globulin (SHBG). SHBG knockdown significantly inhibited M1 macrophage polarization by upregulating SREBP1, a master transcription factor in lipid metabolism. UPLC-Q-TOF-MS analysis revealed that Myricetin (Myr) was one of the main active flavonoid components in WGL. Myr ameliorated the symptoms of arthritis in a spontaneous RA model of IL-1Ra-deficient (IL-1Ra(-/-)) mice. Myr prevented M1 macrophage polarization by inhibiting SHBG to improve SREBP1-mediated lipid metabolism, akin to WGL. These findings highlight that WGL alleviates RA progression by targeting the SHBG-SREBP1 axis to reprogram macrophage lipid metabolism and suppress macrophage M1 polarization, with Myr serving as a key active constituent in WGL. CONCLUSION: This study provides mechanistic evidence to support the modern application of WGL in RA management.
abstract_zh: 背景：类风湿关节炎（RA）主要以巨噬细胞极化失衡为特征。五味甘露（WGL），一种经典藏药外用方剂，已被广泛用于RA的管理。目的：然而，WGL在对抗RA中的潜在机制及其生物活性成分仍不清楚。研究设计：本研究采用多组学策略，以阐明WGL中主要生物活性成分在巨噬细胞极化和RA中的作用及机制。方法：通过流式细胞仪评估巨噬细胞极化，并利用RNA测序、基因干扰技术、分子对接和药理学实验研究WGL的分子机制。结果：WGL通过抑制活性氧（ROS）生成及IL-6/iNOS表达，抑制巨噬细胞M1极化。RNA测序和通路富集分析确定，WGL可能通过作用于性激素结合球蛋白（SHBG）影响脂质代谢。SHBG敲低通过上调SREBP1（脂质代谢中的主转录因子）显著抑制M1巨噬细胞极化。UPLC-Q-TOF-MS分析显示，杨梅素（Myr）是WGL中主要的活性黄酮类成分之一。Myr在IL-1Ra缺陷（IL-1Ra(-/-)）小鼠的自发性RA模型中改善了关节炎症状。Myr通过抑制SHBG以改善SREBP1介导的脂质代谢，从而阻止M1巨噬细胞极化，与WGL作用类似。这些发现强调，WGL通过靶向SHBG-SREBP1轴以重编程巨噬细胞脂质代谢并抑制巨噬细胞M1极化，从而缓解RA进展，其中Myr是WGL中的关键活性成分。结论：本研究为WGL在RA管理中的现代应用提供了机制性证据。
